findings.text: During a 12-second window with no user interaction, the page made 385 requests to 98 third-party domains (median of 3 passes).
Of 66.4 MB transferred in that window (compressed responses that finished loading), 6.9 MB (10%) came from third-party domains, 3.6 MB of it from services classified as tracking (277 requests).

56 third-party services classified as advertising, analytics, social or audience measurement were contacted before any interaction: 1rx.io (RhythmOne (Magnite), advertising), 2mdn.net (Google, advertising), 360yield.com (Improve Digital, advertising), 3lift.com (TripleLift, advertising), acuityplatform.com (Acuity Ads, advertising), adform.net (Adform, advertising), adnxs.com (Microsoft (Xandr), advertising), ads.linkedin.com (LinkedIn, advertising), adsrvr.org (The Trade Desk, advertising), adtrafficquality.google (Google, advertising).
132 cookies were set by third-party domains (178 cookies in total).
The main document response did not include a Content-Security-Policy header or meta tag.
